entry.openPhone: Press Up on the D-pad during gameplay to bring out the phone.
rules: Cheats only appear after you finish the main story. Before that, the Cheats list in the Progress menu stays locked.
Every cheat also has its own unlock challenge, listed next to it below.
Using a cheat disables saving, trophies and achievements for that session, so make a separate save first.
Cheats are a Story Mode feature on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The D-pad sequence is the same on both consoles.

categories.name: Player
categories.description: Money, focus, armor and wanted-level cheats.

categories.name: Vehicle Spawns
categories.description: Cheats that drop a vehicle where you stand.

categories.name: Screen Filters
categories.description: Visual filters for photos, clips and fun runs.

cheats.tip: Use it on a throwaway save to test-drive expensive purchases before committing real story money.

cheats.name: Unlimited Focus
cheats.tip: Pairs well with the shooting-range medal grind if you want to practise aim without a meter running out.

cheats.name: Body Armor
cheats.effect: Adds body armor to your loadout.
cheats.tip: The five Up presses in the middle are the easy place to miscount. Tap them in a steady rhythm.

cheats.name: Raise Heat Level
cheats.effect: Raises your heat level across the map.
cheats.unlock: Lose a three-star wanted level 25 times.
cheats.tip: Only the sixth input differs from Raise Wanted Level (Down here, Right there). Double-check before you enter it.

cheats.name: Raise Wanted Level
cheats.unlock: Lose a three-star wanted level 50 times.
cheats.tip: You unlock Raise Heat Level halfway through this challenge, so both come from the same grind.

cheats.name: Drunk
cheats.effect: Makes you and your partner drunk at once.
cheats.tip: Spending counts in total, so small purchases over many sessions add up.

cheats.name: No Fall Damage
cheats.effect: Makes you immune to fall damage.
cheats.unlock: Survive a fall of 40 feet or more 20 times.
cheats.tip: Save before attempting high falls so a failed landing does not cost progress.

cheats.name: Parachute
cheats.unlock: Complete 50 skydives or BASE jumps from at least 300 feet.
cheats.tip: Both skydives and BASE jumps count toward the same total.

cheats.name: Repair Vehicle
cheats.unlock: Take first place in 10 races at Gellhorn Raceway, Thrillbilly Mud Club and Boone Speedway.
cheats.tip: Track your wins per venue in the Tracker so you know where you still need podiums.

cheats.name: Unlimited Nitrous and Fuel
cheats.effect: Nitrous and fuel never run out.
cheats.tip: Log each completed jump in the Tracker as you go. It is much easier than recounting later.

cheats.name: Max Ammo
cheats.effect: Fills all your ammo to the maximum.
cheats.unlock: Earn 25 bronze-or-better medals at shooting ranges.
cheats.tip: The three ammo cheats share their first seven inputs. Only the last three change.

cheats.name: Infinite Ammo
cheats.unlock: Earn 25 silver-or-better medals at shooting ranges.
cheats.tip: Ends Down, Down, Down. Think of it as the bottom-heavy ammo code.

cheats.name: No Reload
cheats.unlock: Earn 25 gold medals at shooting ranges.
cheats.tip: Same as Infinite Ammo until the final press, which is Up instead of Down.

cheats.name: Attack Force
cheats.effect: Bullets and melee hits launch targets on impact.
cheats.tip: Shares its first five inputs with Exploding Balls and Vehicle Force.

cheats.name: Exploding Balls
cheats.tip: Identical to Attack Force except the last input is Right.

cheats.name: Vehicle Force
cheats.unlock: Kill 25 enemies with a vehicle (civilians count).
cheats.tip: The seventh input is Left, which is the one difference from Attack Force.

cheats.name: All Explosive Weapons
cheats.effect: Gives you the explosive weapons set.
cheats.tip: Thrown grenades count whether or not they hit anything.

cheats.name: Incendiary Ammo
cheats.tip: Grinding Exploding Bottles first gives you plenty of fire damage practice.

cheats.name: Exploding Bottles
cheats.tip: Molotov throws also push you toward the Incendiary Ammo challenge.

cheats.name: Explosive Shotgun (Mason & Keen Shortstraw)
cheats.effect: Gives an explosive Mason & Keen Shortstraw shotgun.
cheats.tip: Shares a counter with Exploding Balls, which unlocks at 20.

cheats.name: Hauners H-AT
cheats.effect: Combat cheat tied to the Hauners H-AT. Exact effect not yet confirmed.
cheats.tip: Destroyed vehicles in any situation count, including during wanted-level chases.

cheats.name: Interstate Ambulance
cheats.unlock: Discover it in the Progress menu.
cheats.tip: Ends Right, Right, Right. The MTL Pumper and HVY Bulldozer codes differ only on the last press.

cheats.name: Airboat 09
cheats.tip: Useful for Grassrivers exploration once unlocked.

cheats.name: Bravado Banshee
cheats.tip: Five combat challenges gives the Speeder 700 GT on the way.

cheats.name: Tuff BMX
cheats.tip: Workouts for Body Armor and fitness challenges can be done in the same sessions.

cheats.name: Maibatsu Boomazoom
cheats.effect: Spawns a Maibatsu Boomazoom where you stand.
cheats.tip: Vehicle spawn codes start Left, Up, Right, Down. Learn that opener once.

cheats.name: Nagasaki Carbon RS
cheats.tip: Five exploration challenges gives the Nagasaki Sea Sparrow on the way.

cheats.name: '65 Vapid Dominator
cheats.tip: The Tuff BMX unlocks at five fitness challenges, halfway there or sooner.

cheats.name: Progen Emerus
cheats.tip: The Lapwing Mallard unlocks at five vehicle challenges.

cheats.name: Inflatable Flamingo
cheats.tip: Count flamingos in the Tracker: the same counter feeds your 100% progress.

cheats.name: MTL Pumper
cheats.unlock: Discover the MTL Pumper in the Progress menu.
cheats.tip: Differs from HVY Bulldozer only on the last input (Up).

cheats.name: Vapid Stanier G2 Taxi
cheats.effect: Spawns a Vapid Stanier G2 Taxi.
cheats.tip: Keep going: every sports challenge unlocks the Brimstone Golfer.

cheats.name: Hauners P-996 Lazer
cheats.tip: This is the capstone reward, so it is the last vehicle cheat most players will see.

cheats.name: HVY Bulldozer
cheats.unlock: Discover the HVY Bulldozer in the Progress menu.
cheats.tip: Ends with Down, where the MTL Pumper ends with Up.

cheats.name: Lapwing Mallard
cheats.tip: Ends Up, Up, Up. First step toward the Progen Emerus.

cheats.name: Brimstone Golfer
cheats.tip: Five sports challenges unlocks the Stanier taxi first.

cheats.name: Hauners Rhino Tank
cheats.tip: Airboat 09 unlocks at five survival challenges on the way.

cheats.name: Maibatsu Sanchez
cheats.tip: Every criminal challenge then adds the Western Zombie Bobber.

cheats.name: Nagasaki Sea Sparrow
cheats.tip: Exploring all six regions of Leonida tends to push this counter naturally.

cheats.name: Speeder 700 GT
cheats.tip: Ends Down, Up, Up. First reward on the combat challenge track.

cheats.name: Truffade Thrax
cheats.tip: The Boomazoom unlocks after five shopping challenges.

cheats.name: Western Zombie Bobber
cheats.tip: The Maibatsu Sanchez arrives first at five.

cheats.name: Cycle Weather
cheats.unlock: Finish the main story. A few guides say you must reveal the whole map instead, so sources differ.
cheats.tip: Enter it repeatedly to step through conditions until you reach the one you want.

cheats.name: Move Time Forward
cheats.effect: Moves the time of day forward.
cheats.tip: Same as Cycle Weather until the last press, which is Up here. The watch counter also unlocks Pause Time of Day at 20.

cheats.name: Pause Time of Day
cheats.tip: Combine with Cycle Weather for screenshots in exactly the light you want.

cheats.name: Golden Hour
cheats.effect: Applies the Golden Hour screen filter.
cheats.unlock: Spend four hours in total holding hands with your partner.
cheats.tip: Ends Up, Up. Time accumulates across sessions, so walk hand in hand between nearby objectives.

cheats.name: Powdered Sugar
cheats.effect: Applies the Powdered Sugar screen filter.
cheats.unlock: Scan all space debris with the WAiNK app.
cheats.tip: Keep WAiNK open while flying or driving through open country.

cheats.name: Pinhole
cheats.unlock: Clear 25 gang operations with your partner.
cheats.tip: Ends Up, Down. Operations cleared solo do not count, so bring your partner.

cheats.name: Neon Jungle
cheats.effect: Applies the Neon Jungle screen filter.
cheats.tip: Log each Girlypop find the moment you spot it.

cheats.name: Yesteryear
cheats.tip: A single-discovery unlock, so it often arrives by accident during exploration.

cheats.name: Cataclysm
cheats.effect: Fills the world with murky smoke.
cheats.unlock: Discover Martha's Vamos in the Progress menu.
cheats.tip: Filter codes start Down, Down, Up, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left. Only the last two inputs change.

cheats.name: Videotape
cheats.tip: Partner activities stack with Dollhouse time, so plan them together.

cheats.name: Dark Mirror
cheats.effect: Applies the Dark Mirror screen filter.
cheats.unlock: Earn $500,000 in total by selling vehicles.
cheats.tip: Enter your running sales total in the Tracker as it grows.

cheats.name: Migraine
cheats.unlock: Survive six minutes at a six-star wanted level.
cheats.tip: Make a dedicated save first. Six-star attempts are where most deaths happen.

cheats.name: Dollhouse
cheats.effect: Applies a vivid filter with a narrow aspect ratio.
cheats.unlock: Spend eight hours with your partner.
cheats.tip: Ends Down, Right. Cataclysm ends Right, Right.

cheats.name: Bubblegum
cheats.unlock: Find all 24 Vice City Flamingos cards.
cheats.tip: Only one of the 18 card sets matters for this cheat.

cheats.name: Fast Forward
cheats.effect: Applies the Fast Forward screen filter.
cheats.tip: Meditations can be repeated, so you do not need 50 different spots.

cheats.name: Fisheye
cheats.tip: A relaxed grind to do between story chapters.

cheats.name: Faded Glory
cheats.effect: Applies a colour CRT TV filter.
cheats.tip: Ends Left, Right. The three found filter codes differ only in their final two inputs.

cheats.name: Pixel Art
cheats.effect: Applies the Pixel Art screen filter.
cheats.unlock: Earn $250,000 in total by selling collectibles.
cheats.tip: Collectible cards sell at pawn shops, which feeds this total.

cheats.name: Hellscape
cheats.tip: Each stolen police vehicle counts once, so mix it into wanted-level escapes.
